objective:
Review this Sol-authored implementation plan for BB's standalone compact PWA. Do not edit files. Return a verdict of ACCEPT or REVISE, then list only material product/UX risks, missing decisions, and concrete plan changes.

Confirmed user intent
- Scope new interaction behavior to installed standalone PWA + compact viewport only.
- The left application sidebar opens only from its explicit button; remove workspace swipe/wheel ownership.
- Short horizontal swipes cycle previous/next tabs in the current persisted workspace.
- A long right swipe opens a full-page Command Center, not a drawer and not a workspace tab.
- Command Center is the existing root compose experience: blank prompt with all agent controls plus Recent; proposed additions are conditional Needs You and Continue Workspace.
- Left swipe from Command Center returns to the preserved prior workspace.
- Page-specific chrome (headers, toolbars, composer/footer, menus, accessory controls) must move with and unmount with the page. No stale chrome may linger after commit/cancel.
- Must work with every left-sidebar variant and all right secondary-panel content/styles. Opening a panel suspends workspace gestures. Navigating closes the drawer but remembers its selected tab and internal scroll.
- Preserve each workspace tab's draft, scroll, focus/selection, and route identity.
- Calm, deliberate motion: direct 1:1 drag; 250ms symmetric page/tab settle; smooth-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); panel 400ms open/350ms close; transform/opacity only during drag; reduced-motion functional fallback; 44px compact hit targets; no transition-all.

Sol technical draft
1. Scope and contracts
   - Add one tested standalone-compact capability helper using display-mode: standalone with iOS navigator.standalone fallback plus compact viewport.
   - Define CompactDestination as workspace pane or command-center, distinct from sidebars and secondary-panel tabs.
   - Define a navigation transaction with phase idle/dragging/settling, source, preview target, commit target, direction, progress, velocity, and cancellation reason.
2. Preserve the workspace model on compact
   - Keep persisted split layout/pane order available when compact, but render only active plus at most one preview pane.
   - Add non-destructive focusCompactPane and showCommandCenter operations. Never send Command Center through route reconciliation that replaces a focused pane.
   - Reuse pane.focus.previous/next semantics; do not reuse sidebar-wide thread.previous/next.
3. Gesture coordinator
   - Extract axis locking, velocity, cancellation, exclusions, and compositor writes from the existing sidebar gesture implementation.
   - Bind only to the active page surface. Ignore inputs/editors/selections/sliders/horizontal scrollers/open overlays and opt-out nodes.
   - Short left/right commits adjacent workspace pane by distance or velocity. Long right crossing 65-70% changes the preview destination to Command Center with resistance and a static threshold cue.
   - Preserve Safari's 24px browser history edge outside standalone; behavior is disabled outside standalone compact mode.
   - Remove global swipe and wheel-to-open sidebar behavior while retaining button open and drawer swipe-to-close.
4. Page transition host and chrome ownership
   - Introduce a compact page transition host above complete destination surfaces. Each surface owns its header, body, footer/composer, and accessory chrome.
   - During drag only source+preview exist. Source becomes inert once commit begins. On settlement, atomically promote target and unmount source; on cancel, remove preview and restore source.
   - Close menus/popovers/drawers and release focus/pointer capture on navigation start. Prevent duplicate toolbar/accessibility-tree entries.
   - Keep data caches and per-pane UI state outside the transient presentation wrapper.
5. Command Center
   - Treat RootComposeView as the product Command Center while route may remain /.
   - Structure: composer first; conditional Needs You; conditional Continue Workspace; Recent. Avoid empty dashboard furniture.
   - Recent/attention rows: 44px+, project, concise status, last activity, agent state. Selecting focuses/opens thread; submitting composer creates thread.
   - The Command Center is preserved as a top-level destination, never inserted into or used to replace the pane tree.
6. Panel choreography and compact UI
   - A shared gesture arbitration contract covers standard/floating/inset and left/right sidebar variants plus ResponsiveDrawerShell content.
   - Navigation closes open drawers; drawer handle retains its own swipe-to-close; nested drawers block page gestures.
   - Use content-fit secondary sheets for Info/metadata and near-full height for diff/file/terminal/plugin surfaces.
   - Stabilize compact header slots; expose a subtle “2 of 4” workspace indicator. Tapping opens an accessible workspace switcher.
7. Craft, accessibility, performance
   - Apply 44px hit areas, 0.96 press scale where appropriate, antialiased root text, explicit transition properties, optical icon alignment, restrained shadows/radii.
   - Reduced motion uses short opacity/state change, no positional settle, with polite tab announcements.
   - Preserve per-pane scroll/draft/focus; freeze timeline position when user is away from latest; stable return-to-latest control.
   - Replace null route Suspense with stable shell skeleton. Defer broad service-worker caching to a separate plan.
8. Delivery sequence
   A. State contracts + non-destructive compact pane navigation.
   B. Gesture ownership migration + tests.
   C. Transition host/chrome lifecycle + Command Center round-trip.
   D. Panel arbitration + workspace switcher.
   E. touch/craft/accessibility/loading polish.
   F. iPhone standalone QA and performance validation.
   Keep server/daemon protocols untouched unless discovery proves a wire change is necessary.
9. Acceptance
   - Standalone compact-only gating; desktop/Safari-tab behavior unchanged.
   - Short swipes work across 1-8 panes, boundaries resist, long swipe never destroys panes.
   - Exactly one active page toolbar/composer exists after commit/cancel and one active page is exposed to accessibility.
   - Every sidebar/secondary-panel style passes closed/open/dragging/nested cases.
   - No gesture starts from excluded controls; orientation/pointercancel/interruption settles deterministically.
   - Reduced motion, VoiceOver, 44px targets, draft/scroll restoration pass.
   - 60fps target on older iPhone-class hardware; no blank frame on cold lazy route.
acceptance_checks: Verdict is explicit: ACCEPT or REVISE.
Review addresses gesture semantics, Command Center mental model, chrome lifecycle, panel coexistence, discoverability/accessibility, and scope sequencing.
Recommendations are concrete enough for Sol to accept or reject in a final implementation plan.
